newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners tenders for Caremark '03 notes.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners tenders for Caremark '03 notes.

text.p: MedPartners Inc said it has commenced a cash tender offer and consent solicitation for all of the 6-7/8 percent notes due August 2003 of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Caremark International Inc.
An aggregate of $100 million principal amount of notes is presently outstanding, MedPartners said.
The purchase price for each note tendered will be based on a fixed spread of 37.5 basis points over the yield on the 5-3/4 percent U.S. Treasury Note due August 15, 2003.
The purchase price will be set at 1400 EDT on October 24, 1996, the third business day prior to the scheduled expiration date of the offer.

MedPartners, on behalf of Caremark, is soliciting consents to amend the indenture governing the notes to eliminate or modify many of the restrictive covenants in an effort to improve the operating and financial flexibility of the companies, the firm said. MedPartners has offered to pay each consenting holder a cash amount equal to 0.5 percent of the principal amount of the notes ($5 per $1000 note).
The two companies in May announced they would merge in a stock deal valued at $2.5 billion.
